newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran mines minister designate plans greater output.
newsitem.headline: Iran mines minister designate plans greater output.

text.p: Iran's mines and metals minister designate plans to oversee increased production of steel, copper and aluminium if confirmed in the post, the official news agency IRNA reported on Sunday.
Eshaq Jahangiri would boost the mineral sector and implement projects to increase capacity at several metals plants, the agency said.
The National Iranian Steel Co has set a production target of seven million tonnes over the next year, up from the six million tonnes produced in the year to March 20.

Most of the increase would come from boosted output at the Isfahan steel mill in central Iran, the nearby Mobarakeh complex and a plant in the southwestern city of Ahvaz, the agency quoted Jahangiri as saying.
"The capacity of the Sarcheshmeh copper complex is to increase to 200,000 tonnes a year," Jahangiri said.

Iran said in July it had signed a contract with three foreign firms, from Japan and Australia, to develop copper smelting works at Sarcheshmeh, which would double annual production at the complex to 200,000 tonnes.
